description: This Dart file defines a ThemeConfig class that provides a static method to generate a Flutter ThemeData object with a custom color palette and style configuration for a Flutter application.

classes.name: ThemeConfig
classes.description: A utility class for providing the application's theme settings including color scheme and widget styles.

methods.name: get theme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean Professional color palette and customized styles, using Material 3 design principles.
